data.paraphrase: For every natural number N, consider functions a, b, and c from Fin N to integers. If N is at least 1 and for every element j in Fin N, at least one of a_j, b_j, or c_j is odd, then there exist integers r, s, and t such that the number of elements j in Fin N for which r*a_j + s*b_j + t*c_j is odd is at least (4*N)/7.
